claim: ISCXVPN2016 can be downloaded via the CIC request form without login, and redistribution/use is permitted provided the dataset and the ICISSP 2016 paper are cited.
evidence: (1) The ISCXVPN2016 page (unb.ca/cic/datasets/vpn.html) states the dataset "is publicly available for researchers", asks users to cite Draper-Gil, Lashkari, Mamun & Ghorbani, "Characterization of Encrypted and VPN Traffic Using Time-Related Features", ICISSP 2016, pp. 407-414, and links "Download this dataset" to http://cicresearch.ca/CICDataset/ISCX-VPN-NonVPN-2016/. (2) That download URL serves a "CIC DATASET DOWNLOAD FORM" collecting First Name, Last Name, Email, Organization, Job Title, Country, with a disclaimer that the information is used only for internal CIC statistics; no login or password field. At fetch time (2026-10-18) the form page displayed "Server error. Please try again later." (3) The CIC datasets FAQ (unb.ca/cic/datasets/index.html) states verbatim: "We do not use login pages and passwords to download our datasets", "We do have a short form to collect basic data for reporting, but this does not require a password", and "With any of our datasets, you may redistribute, republish, and mirror our datasets in any form. However, any use or redistribution of the data must include a citation to the dataset and the research paper listed"; the same permission is stated for commercial use by private companies. Caveat: there is no formal named licence (e.g. CC-BY) on the dataset page; the permission is a site-wide policy statement plus the citation request on the dataset page.
correction: Claim holds. Precise wording: ISCXVPN2016 is downloaded via a no-password CIC request form (name, email, organization, job title, country). CIC's site-wide policy permits redistribution, republishing, mirroring and commercial use of its datasets provided every use/redistribution cites the dataset and the listed paper (Draper-Gil et al., ICISSP 2016). There is no formal named licence text on the dataset page; document the CIC policy statement and the citation as the licence basis. Note the download form returned a transient server error at check time, so download availability should be verified before relying on it.
impact_on_candidate: No negative impact. The optional ML pre-training/ablation can use ISCXVPN2016 with licence documentation consisting of the CIC redistribution policy quote plus the ICISSP 2016 citation. Minor risks: (a) the mandatory licence-documentation constraint should cite the CIC FAQ statement rather than claim a formal open licence; (b) the CIC download form was returning a server error when checked, so the team should download early and keep a local copy, or have a fallback dataset if the form is unavailable during the hackathon.
